title: Degree under coordinate pullback
statement: Let $r,s\ge 0$, let $f:\mathbb{F}_2^s\to\mathbb{F}_2$ be a Boolean function, and let $e:\{1,\ldots,s\}\hookrightarrow\{1,\ldots,r\}$ be an injection. The algebraic degree over $\mathbb{F}_2$ of the function on $\mathbb{F}_2^r$ obtained by evaluating $f$ on the coordinates selected by $e$ is at most the algebraic degree of $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $s$-dimensional binary cube
$e$ is an injective map from the $s$ coordinates to the $r$ coordinates
